name: emit
description: Report one line and finish this turn. On the call that ends the job, set finish=true and put the final document in summary -- that single call ends the job and is the deliverable.

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: ONE line for a normal round; the FINAL document when finish=true

parameters.name: finish
parameters.description: true only on the call that ends the job, when the whole research job is finished and reviewed
